Cinq ans autour du monde sur le Beagle,: Five years around the world on the Beagle, twenty years of thought before publishing On the Origin of Species in 1859. He drew up a list of the pros and cons of marriage. Conclusion: “Marry, marry, marry.”
Avec ses flacons à col de cygne, il mont: With his swan-neck flasks, he showed that microbes don't arise spontaneously. In 1885, he vaccinated young Joseph Meister against rabies. His notebooks, open to researchers after 1971, show that he sometimes tidied up his results.
Sa « photo 51 », une image de diffractio: Her “Photo 51”, a diffraction image of DNA, was shown to Watson without her knowledge, and helped him find the double helix. She died at 37, four years before the Nobel awarded to Watson, Crick and Wilkins.
Médecin du prince samanide à 17 ans, il: Physician to the Samanid prince at 17, he wrote the Canon of Medicine, taught in Europe until the 17th century. In it he calls for testing a remedy on simple cases and repeating the trial. He tells of reading Aristotle's Metaphysics forty times without understanding it, until a short commentary by al-Farabi made it clear.
Peintre et naturaliste, elle élève des c: A painter and naturalist, she raised caterpillars and drew each stage of their metamorphosis with the plant that fed them. At 52, she left for Suriname with her daughter. Her plate of a tarantula devouring a bird was taken for an invention. Naturalists proved her right in the 19th century.
Fille d'un menuisier de Lyme Regis, elle: The daughter of a carpenter from Lyme Regis, she searched the cliffs after storms. She found the first complete plesiosaur skeleton and ichthyosaurs that proved species had gone extinct. Being a woman and poor, she wasn't admitted to the Geological Society, and others published her finds.
À Vienne, la maternité tenue par les méd: In Vienna, the maternity ward run by doctors kills far more mothers than the one run by midwives. He compares, eliminates hypotheses one by one, and understands: the doctors come straight from the dissecting room. Handwashing with chlorine makes mortality plummet. His colleagues, offended, reject him. He died in an asylum.
Il découvre la pénicilline en 1928, mais: He discovered penicillin in 1928, but couldn't purify it. It took Howard Florey, Ernst Chain, Norman Heatley and giant fermentation tanks to make it a drug, in 1943: it's biotechnology that saves lives, not the mold alone. The 1945 Nobel rewarded the three researchers.
